notes: Bites (BIT) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its zero-argument constructor mints 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It has no administrative powers or transfer fees. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
